description: This Python source file contains utility functions and rules for tensor sharding and distribution strategies within the PyTorch distributed tensor framework. It includes functions for generating sharding suggestions based on einsum notation, pointwise operations, and handling partial sums, primarily supporting distributed tensor operations and sharding propagation logic.
